correctness.rationale: For integer m, Gamma(r+m)/Gamma(r)=prod_{j=0}^{m-1}(r+j). Therefore the log derivative is sum 1/(r+j)+log q and the second derivative is strictly negative. It runs from +infinity to log q<0, yielding one mode and immediate failure of complete monotonicity for m>=1; m=0 is the exponential q^r. The digamma expansion with r=qm/(1-q)+1/2+b/m gives b=-(1-q^2)/(24q), and the derivative of the mode equation is order 1/m, upgrading the residual to the stated O(m^-2) root error. Independent numerical roots at q=0.2,0.5,0.8 and m through 1000 agreed with the expansion at the expected scale.

final_claim: For a fixed interior negative-multinomial cell of total count m, the ordinary real shape coordinate is completely and logarithmically completely monotone only when m=0; for m>=1 the cell mass is strictly log-concave with a unique mode solving sum_{j=0}^{m-1}(r+j)^{-1}=-log q, depending only on m and q, with the stated three-term large-m expansion.
scientific_limitations: An equivalent shape-mode calculation may occur in unindexed negative-binomial/negative-multinomial likelihood literature.
Only the ordinary shape coordinate at fixed interior probability vector is classified; coupled reparameterizations and probability-coordinate monotonicity are not addressed.
